name: Stale cards nudge
summary: Find cards whose claim went stale, stuck or blocked and propose one friendly nudge comment for each, at most once a week.

routes.how: Read the local board and source files

flow.title: Once a day
flow.text: Runs on the shared automation schedule.

flow.title: Read the board
flow.text: Reads the local board and its stale time setting. Read only.

flow.title: Find stale cards
flow.text: A small script lists stale, stuck or blocked claims. It skips waiting and held cards and cards nudged this week. No AI.

flow.title: Write a nudge
flow.text: An agent reads each card and drafts a short nudge with options and a recommendation.

flow.title: Review Inbox
flow.text: Each nudge waits there as a proposal. Nothing is posted until you accept it.
